component.name: Menagerie
component.summary: Browse, install and summon Shimeji characters

description.p: Shimeji are the little mascots that walk around your screen, climb your windows and throw themselves off the edges. Menagerie is a front end for wl_shimeji, the Wayland engine that draws them.

ul.li: A catalog of a few thousand characters with animated previews and one-click install
A collection view with favorites, groups and export
A scene with presets, and a way to bring back everyone if the overlay stops
Start at login, with a random selection if you like

description.p: The engine, wl_shimeji, is a separate program and has to be installed as well.
